items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉台塑、南亞估Q4業績優於Q3 南亞電子材料維持「量增、價漲」
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics' Four-Product Business Beats Q3; Nan Ya Electronics Materials Maintains "Higher Volume, Higher Prices"
paras: 台塑(1301-TW)四寶今(6)日公告10月營收及未來展望，台塑受惠於年底前「金九銀十」旺季及感恩節加持，雖在美國選舉變天、油價難以預期走勢下，第4季優於第3季；南亞(1303-TW)則認為在AI高階材料第4季將在「量增、價漲」的貢獻下看好11月、第4季業績優於前季。
台塑四寶上(10)月營收揭曉，台塑、南亞(1303-TW)、台化(1323-TW)皆繳出年月雙增，南亞單月更創近55個月新高。
台塑指出，第4季因適逢感恩節、聖誕節及中國網購等各種民生消費需求，為PE/PP包裝材、EVA鞋材、PP玩具及家電用品等傳統需求旺季，皆有利台塑產品銷售，加上中國持續推出刺激經濟措施，可望帶動石化產品需求增加。
此外，台塑強調，中東衝突未歇，原油及原料乙、丙烯維持高檔下，也支撐石化產品行情，本公司開工率及產銷量比第3季提高，預估第4季營業額比第3季成長。
南亞表示，11月及第四季合併營收將持續攀升，主要仍受惠於各項電子材料及載板等需求暢旺，價量齊揚，隨著AI應用推進，硬體發展對於電子材料需求更為強勁，南亞電子材料及南電(8046-TW)產能規模及技術能力的優勢將持續發威，受惠電子材料市場暢旺，將帶動中高階材料銷售、營收成長。
台化則認為，在11月5日民主黨贏得期中選舉、以色列國會變天下，中東衝突不太可能進一步升溫，油價將隨即反應，台化既有的原料及成品庫存，短期會有跌價損失，權益法收入也會受到影響，但公司一向採取低庫存操作，庫存損失可控，在上游原料跌價，公司將謹慎採購，將衝擊降至最低。
至於油價走勢預期，台塑化(6505-TW)強調，在美國大選共和黨慘敗下，將意味美國國會將拒絕為戰爭提供後續的軍事經費，致11月油價大幅下滑；汽油受惠於輕油供給緊縮，輕油價差持續強勢，維持整體輕質油品利差穩健，整體煉油製毛利依然位於高檔。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics (1301-TW) announced its October revenue and outlook today (the 6th). Benefiting from the "golden September, silver October" peak season and Thanksgiving, Formosa posted a stronger Q4 than Q3 despite the U.S. election shake‑up and uncertain oil prices. Nan Ya (1303-TW) expects its Q4 performance to improve over the prior quarter, driven by higher volume and higher prices in AI‑related advanced electronic materials.

Formosa's four‑product segment revealed October revenue, with Formosa, Nan Ya (1303-TW) and Formosa Chemical (1323-TW) all delivering double‑digit year‑over‑year growth, and Nan Ya achieving its highest monthly revenue in about 55 months.

Formosa noted that Q4 coincides with Thanksgiving, Christmas and Chinese e‑commerce demand, creating a traditional peak season for PE/PP packaging, EVA shoe material, PP toys and home‑appliance goods, all of which boost sales of its products. In addition, continued stimulus measures in China are expected to lift demand for petrochemical products.

Formosa also emphasized that, although the Middle‑East conflict persists and crude oil and feedstock ethylene and propylene remain at high levels, these factors support petrochemical pricing. The company's operating rate and production‑sales volume are higher than in Q3, and it forecasts Q4 revenue to grow versus Q3.

Nan Ya said that combined revenue for November and Q4 will keep rising, mainly due to strong demand for various electronic materials and substrates, with both price and volume increasing. As AI applications advance, hardware development further strengthens demand for electronic materials. Nan Ya's electronic‑material and Nan Dian (8046‑TW) capacity and technology advantages will continue to shine, driving mid‑to‑high‑end material sales and revenue growth.

Formosa Chemical stated that after the Democrats win the November 5 mid‑term elections and Israel’s parliament changes, the Middle‑East conflict is unlikely to intensify, and oil prices will adjust accordingly. Existing raw‑material and finished‑goods inventories will incur short‑term price‑losses, and equity‑method income will be affected, but the company’s low‑inventory strategy keeps losses manageable. With upstream raw‑material price declines, the firm will purchase cautiously to minimize impact.

Regarding oil‑price outlook, Formosa Chemical (6505‑TW) stressed that the Republican defeat in the U.S. election will likely lead Congress to refuse further war‑related military funding, causing a sharp drop in oil prices in November. Gasoline will benefit from tighter light‑oil supply, keeping the light‑oil price spread strong and maintaining robust margins for light‑product refining, so overall refining gross margins remain high.

items.title: 比亞迪：仰望U9X於阿布達比跑出503.17km/h 創量產車極速紀錄
items.title_en: BYD: Yangwang U9X Hits 503.17 km/h in Abu Dhabi, Sets Production Car Speed Record
paras: 中國車企比亞迪(002594-CN)(01211-HK)旗下高端品牌仰望汽車宣布，其旗艦純電超級跑車 U9 Xtreme(簡稱 U9X)於 2026 年 11 月 1 日在阿拉伯聯合大公國阿布達比 Al Dhafrah 地區的 E11 高速公路封閉路段，成功創下 503.17 km/h 的極速成績。
這項測試由車手 Marc Basseng 駕駛完成，並獲得國際汽車聯盟(FIA)與金氏世界紀錄(Guinness World Records)雙重認證，刷新量產汽車單方向行駛最高速度紀錄。
此前，量產車極速紀錄由仰望 U9X 於 2025 年 9 月在德國 ATP 測試場創下的 496.22 km/h 保持；更早之前的燃油量產車紀錄則為布加迪(Bugatti)Chiron Super Sport 300+ 於 2019 年寫下的 490.484 km/h。
仰望汽車總經理胡曉慶表示，團隊過去數月持續尋找適合極速挑戰的直線公路，相比專業封閉測試場，阿布達比的開放公路需額外克服環境高溫、側風及沙塵等自然變數。
比亞迪集團執行副總裁李柯曾透露，在先前跑出 496.22 km/h 時，遠端測量數據顯示車手仍有 1.5 秒的全油門空間未發揮。此外，在阿布達比測試前，測試車手江穩於中國大陸進行摸底測試期間曾於 420–450 km/h 高速下撞擊護欄，車輛受損嚴重但人員平安。

在車輛工程規格方面，仰望 U9X 採用全域 1200V 超高壓平台，配置 4 台最高轉速達 30,000 rpm 的高性能電動馬達，整車綜合輸出功率超過 3,000 匹馬力(約 3,019 Ps)，推重比為 1,217 Ps/t。底盤與電池架構上，該車配備雲輦-X 智慧底盤系統、30C 賽道級刀片電池與碳纖維車身結構，並搭配與佳通(Giti)聯合開發、加入芳綸纖維的 GitiSport e·GTR2 PRO 半熱熔輪胎，以因應 500 km/h 以上的物理極限。
除了直線極速，仰望 U9X 亦曾在德國紐博格林北環賽道跑出 6 分 59 秒 157 的單圈圈速。
針對此次測試結果，比亞迪執行副總裁李柯評價指出，工程團隊在先前取得 496.22 km/h 成績後即持續進行數據複盤，進一步優化熱管理效率與馬達響應。
仰望 U9X 全球限量生產 30 台，單車售價逾 2,000 萬人民幣，目前已全數售罄。
paras_en: China's automaker BYD (002594-CN)(01211-HK) high‑end brand Yangwang announced that its flagship all‑electric supercar U9 Xtreme (U9X) achieved a top speed of 503.17 km/h on November 1, 2026, on a closed section of the E11 highway in the Al Dhafrah area of Abu Abd i, United Arab Emirates.

The test was driven by Marc Basseng and received dual certification from the International Automobile Federation (FIA) and Guinness World Records, breaking the record for the highest one‑way speed of a production vehicle.

Previously, the production‑car speed record of 496.22 km/h was set by the Yangwang U9X in September 2025 at the ATP test site in Germany; the earlier gasoline production‑car record was held by Bugatti’s Chiron Super Sport 300+ at 490.484 km/h in 2019.

Yangwang’s general manager Hu Xiaoqing said the team spent months searching for a suitable straight road for the speed attempt, noting that the open highway in Abu Abd i presented extra challenges such as extreme heat, crosswinds and sand compared with a dedicated test track.

BYD executive vice‑president Li Ke disclosed that when the car previously hit 496.22 km/h, remote data showed the driver still had about 1.5 seconds of full‑throttle margin. He also noted that before the Abu Abd i run, test driver Jiang Wen suffered a severe crash into a barrier at 420‑450 km/h during a shakedown in mainland China, damaging the car but leaving the crew unharmed.

In terms of engineering, the Yangwang U9X uses a global 1200 V ultra‑high‑voltage platform with four high‑performance electric motors each capable of 30,000 rpm, delivering over 3,000 hp (≈3,019 Ps) and a power‑to‑weight ratio of 1,217 Ps/t. The chassis and battery architecture feature the Yunlian‑X intelligent chassis system, a 30C track‑grade blade battery and carbon‑fiber body, paired with a Giti‑co‑developed GitiSport e·GTR2 PRO semi‑solid tire reinforced with aramid fiber to withstand speeds above 500 km/h.
Beyond straight‑line speed, the Yangwang U9X also recorded a lap time of 6 minutes 59.157 seconds on the Nürburgring Nordschleife in Germany.

Commenting on the result, BYD executive vice‑president Li Ke said the engineering team continued data debriefs after the 496.22 km/h run, further optimizing thermal‑management efficiency and motor response.
The Yangwang U9X is limited to 30 units worldwide, priced at over RMB 20 million each, and all units have already been sold out.

items.title: 金管會祭三招救市 調降借券賣出額度、調高融券保證金成數、放寬多元擔保品
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Unveils Three Market-Stabilizing Measures: Lowering Short-Selling Limits, Raising Margin Requirements, and Expanding Eligible Collateral
paras: 繼國安基金宣布決議進場執行護盤任務後，金管會今 (6) 日晚間亦祭出限空令，證期局宣布，自9日起調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限，同步調高融券保證金成數，期望透過多項穩定措施，抑制極端空頭炒作，並同步擴大投資人補繳擔保品的管道，全力維護資本市場穩定。
受國際政經情勢影響，近期台股出現非理性連續下跌，金管會已持續密切掌握國際金融情勢及全球股市變化，並備妥相關應變措施。金管會表示，為維持證券市場之秩序及穩定性，決定自下周一(11/9)實施兩項措施。
首先，調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量，由原不超過該種有價證券前30個營業日之日平均成交數量之30%調降為3%，但證券商因發行認售權證、指數投資證券、營業處所經營結構型商品與股權衍生性商品交易業務、擔任受益憑證流動量提供者或期貨自營商擔任股票選擇權或股票期貨造市者等避險需求、或證券商擔任股票造市者提供買賣報價或避險需求之借券賣出，得不受限制。
其次，上市及上櫃有價證券之最低融券保證金成數由90%調整為130%。
為避免市場震盪引發連鎖斷頭賣壓，金管會亦同步強化投資人的資金與資產運用彈性。投資人經證券金融事業或證券商同意，除了已納入的上市(櫃)股票零股及興櫃股票外，亦得使用具有市場流動性且能被客觀合理評估價值之其他多元擔保品(例如複委託之外國有價證券等)，來補繳融資自備款或融券保證金差額。
此外，金管會表示，現行上市櫃公司買回庫藏股已採電子化申報，鼓勵上市櫃公司可視自身資金調度、財務狀況及買回目的，適時評估實施庫藏股。
金管會並鼓勵上市櫃公司適時召開法人說明會或參與主題式業績發表會，主動對外說明公司營運現況、財務表現、產業展望及未來發展策略。
金管會強調，將持續關注國際金融情勢變化，及國內資本市場狀況，適時調整上述穩定措施，建議投資人依本身投資策略審慎投資，理性因應。
paras_en: Following the National Security Fund’s decision to intervene and support the market, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) also issued a short‑selling restriction on the evening of the 6th. The Securities and Futures Bureau announced that starting on the 9th, the daily intraday limit on short‑sale orders will be reduced, while the margin requirement for securities lending will be increased, aiming to curb extreme short‑selling activity and broaden channels for investors to post additional collateral, thereby safeguarding market stability.

Due to recent international political and economic developments, Taiwan’s stock market has experienced an irrational, continuous decline. The FSC has been closely monitoring global financial conditions and stock‑market movements and has prepared contingency measures. It said that to maintain order and stability in the securities market, two measures will be implemented starting next Monday (Nov 9).

First, the daily intraday limit on short‑sale orders will be cut from 30% of the average daily volume over the preceding 30 trading days to just 3%. However, securities firms engaged in hedging activities—such as issuing warrants, index‑linked securities, structured products, equity‑derivative transactions, acting as liquidity providers for unit trusts, or market‑making in stock options or futures—will be exempt from this restriction.
Second, the minimum margin requirement for securities lending on listed and over‑the‑counter securities will be raised from 90% to 130%.

To prevent market turbulence from triggering a cascade of forced sales, the FSC will also enhance investors’ flexibility in using funds and assets. With approval from a securities‑finance business or broker, investors may, in addition to listed (OTC) stocks and emerging‑board shares already permitted, use other liquid, objectively‑valued collateral—such as foreign securities held in a custodial account—to meet margin shortfalls for financing or securities‑lending positions.

The FSC also noted that the current electronic filing system for share buy‑backs by listed companies encourages firms to assess their cash needs, financial condition, and buy‑back objectives, and to consider timely repurchases when appropriate.

It further encourages listed companies to hold corporate‑investor briefings or participate in thematic earnings presentations, proactively explaining their operational status, financial performance, industry outlook, and future strategies to the market.

The FSC emphasized that it will continuously monitor international financial developments and domestic capital‑market conditions, adjusting the stabilization measures as needed, and advises investors to invest prudently according to their own strategies and respond rationally.

items.title: 美國民主黨計劃對蘋果、Meta展開調查
items.title_en: U.S. Democrats Plan to Investigate Apple, Meta
paras: 美國民主黨準備將調查矛頭指向多家科技巨頭，蘋果(AAPL-US) 、Meta(META-US) 以及全球首富馬斯克旗下公司均被列入調查目標。
據《華盛頓郵報》6日（周五）報導，民主黨計劃針對科技企業多項業務和政策爭議展開調查，涉及馬斯克旗下AI聊天機器人Grok、蘋果應用商店中ICE追蹤應用，以及Meta與地方政府達成的資料中心協議。
具體來看，民主黨計劃調查美國總統川普在委內瑞拉軍事行動中使用Grok一事，重點涉及馬斯克旗下AI工具在相關行動中的使用情況。
蘋果也將面臨調查。民主黨計劃審查蘋果應用商店為何上架用於追蹤美國移民與海關執法局（ICE）執法人員的應用程式。
Meta則因其與地方政府簽署的資料中心協議成為調查目標。民主黨計劃審查Meta與地方政府達成的相關協議，關注資料中心項目具體安排。
paras_en: U.S. Democrats are preparing to target several tech giants, with Apple (AAPL-US), Meta (META-US) and companies owned by the world’s richest man, Elon Musk, all listed as investigation targets.

According to a Washington Post report on Friday the 6th, Democrats plan to launch investigations into multiple business and policy controversies involving tech firms, covering Musk’s AI chatbot Grok, an ICE-tracking app in Apple’s App Store, and a data‑center agreement between Meta and local governments.
Specifically, Democrats intend to probe President Trump’s use of Grok in the Venezuelan military operation, focusing on how Musk’s AI tool was employed in that action.
Apple will also face scrutiny. Democrats plan to examine why the App Store listed an application used to track U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers.
Meta is a target because of its data‑center agreements with local governments. Democrats will review those agreements, focusing on the specific arrangements of the data‑center projects.

items.title: 中鋼Q3每股賺0.07元 投資10.79億元布局SOFC因應製程電氣化
items.title_en: China Steel Q3 EPS 0.07 NT$, invests NT$10.79 billion in SOFC to support process electrification
paras: 中鋼(2002-TW)今(6)日召開董事會，通過第三季財報，稅後純益11.21億元，季減46%，較去年同期虧轉盈，每股純益0.07元；累計前三季稅後純益7.43億元、每股純益0.05元，也較去年同期轉盈。
此外，中鋼董事會也通過投資10.79億元，推動固態氧化物燃料電池(SOFC)暨碳捕捉與利用計畫，預計自2026年12月1日起至2028年12月31日止，計畫期程為2年1個月。
中鋼表示，此次投資主要是因應未來製程電氣化的電力需求，並配合2030年後碳中和及製程電氣化策略，藉此強化能源運用彈性及營運穩定性。
財報方面，中鋼第三季營收886.69億元，季減0.19%、年增20.61%；營業利益15.01億元，季減59.07%，較去年同期轉盈。累計前三季營收2566.71億元，年增6.2%；營業利益45.46億元，也較去年同期虧轉盈。
paras_en: China Steel (2002‑TW) held its board meeting today (the 6th) and approved its third‑quarter financial results, reporting a post‑tax net profit of NT$1.121 billion, down 46% quarter‑over‑quarter but turning a loss into profit year‑over‑year, with earnings of NT$0.07 per share. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, net profit was NT$743 million, or NT$0.05 per share, also a swing to profit from the prior year.

The board also approved an investment of NT$10.79 billion to advance a solid‑oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and carbon capture and utilization program, scheduled to run from December 1 2026 to December 31 2028, a duration of two years and one month.

China Steel said the investment is primarily to meet the electricity demand of future process electrification and to align with its post‑2030 carbon‑neutral and process‑electrification strategy, thereby strengthening energy‑use flexibility and operational stability.

In the earnings report, China Steel’s third‑quarter revenue was NT$88.669 billion, down 0.19% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 20.61% year‑over‑year. Operating profit was NT$1.501 billion, down 59.07% quarter‑over‑quarter yet turning a loss into profit year‑over‑year. For the first three quarters, cumulative revenue reached NT$256.671 billion, up 6.2% year‑over‑year, and operating profit was NT$4.546 billion, also a swing from loss to profit compared with the prior year.

items.title: 敦泰Q4出貨、營收估續降 AMOLED驅動IC年底拚月出貨百萬顆挹注毛利
items.title_en: Dun Tai Q4 Shipments and Revenue Expected to Keep Falling; AMOLED Driver IC Aims for Monthly Million-Unit Shipments by Year-End to Boost Margins
paras: 敦泰(3545-TW)今(6)日舉行法說會，因全球安卓手機、平板及筆記型電腦出貨持續下滑，第三季消費性電子產品雖進入傳統旺季，品牌客戶拉貨或備貨的速度並未明顯增加，公司整體出貨量略低於上季，第三季稅後純益為0.61億元，每股純益0.29元。展望第四季，由於客戶拉貨偏向保守，預估出貨及營收將持續下滑，但毛利率有望持續增長，其中，AMOLED 顯示驅動IC產品年底將達成每月百萬顆出貨規模。
敦泰第三季營收為新台幣27.24億元，季減1.1%，年減12.3% 。在獲利表現方面，因公司持續優化產能配置，優先將資源投入高附加價值及策略性產品，同時逐步調漲產品價格，帶動第三季毛利率較上季增加3.2個百分點，毛利額達6.95億元，季增13.4%。營業費用則維持穩定，與上季相當，約新台幣7.7億元，使本季營業虧損明顯收斂。加計業外收益挹注，第三季稅後純益為0.61億元，EPS 0.29 元。
在資產負債表方面，公司財務結構維持穩健。截至第三季底，現金及金融資產約新台幣71.09億元，占總資產超過五成，資金水位充裕。存貨方面，因全球供應鏈不確定性增大，為降低供貨風險，公司逐步調整庫存水位，第三季存貨較上季增加18.2%。此外，股東權益較上季增加0.9%，每股淨值由40.96元提升至41.33元。
展望第四季，敦泰表示，受到原物料供貨不足、生產成本上升，消費性電子市場持續疲弱，加上大陸內需環境不確定性影響，終端市場復甦動能仍顯不足，品牌客戶拉貨態度審慎。預期第四季出貨量及營收將持續下滑，但因高端產品的陸續推出及產品組合的優化，在毛利率方面，則有望持續增長。
AMOLED 顯示驅動IC產品方面，敦泰指出，經過數年的技術耕耘，已獲多家主流品牌客戶認證，預期出貨將逐季成長，年底將達成每月百萬顆等級的出貨規模。受惠於產品毛利率較佳，將可進一步挹注公司營收及獲利。
在AMOLED觸控產品方面，敦泰成功推出業界首款單顆即可支援至21吋柔性螢幕的車用觸控IC，透過雙晶片級聯技術，更可支援高達35吋的大尺寸螢幕，目前產品已通過AEC-Q100車規認證，展現在高階車載觸控產品的領先優勢。近日已成功導入理想汽車高階豪華車款MEGA，搭配21吋面板，應用於後艙4K娛樂螢幕。這不僅是敦泰在大尺寸AMOLED觸控領域的重要里程碑，也為未來車用業務成長注入新的動能。
在新技術開發方面，公司成功開發出全球領先的 Fortis Touch 防水觸控技術，突破傳統觸控螢幕在積水或暴雨環境下容易發生誤觸或操作失靈的技術瓶頸。此項新技術有效地解決了在戶外場景使用的產品，如穿戴、手機、工控，充電樁以及二輪車市場等長期以來的使用痛點，推出後獲得市場高度關注及客戶熱烈迴響。未來公司將積極推動產品導入，開拓新的成長機會。
paras_en: Dun Tai (3545-TW) held an earnings conference today (the 6th). Due to continued declines in global Android smartphone, tablet and notebook shipments, the third quarter saw consumer electronics enter the traditional peak season, but brand customers did not noticeably increase pull‑in or stock‑up orders. Overall shipments were slightly lower than the previous quarter, and third‑quarter net profit after tax was NT$61 million, or NT$0.29 per share. Looking ahead to Q4, because customers are pulling in conservatively, shipments and revenue are expected to keep falling, but gross margin should continue to improve, with the AMOLED display driver IC product expected to reach a monthly shipment scale of one million units by year‑end.

Dun Tai’s third‑quarter revenue was NT$2.724 billion, down 1.1% sequentially and 12.3% year‑over‑year. On the profit side, the company kept optimizing capacity allocation, prioritizing high‑value‑added and strategic products while gradually raising product prices, which lifted the gross margin by 3.2 percentage points from the prior quarter, resulting in a gross profit of NT$695 million, up 13.4% sequentially. Operating expenses remained stable at about NT$770 million, similar to the previous quarter, allowing the operating loss to narrow sharply. Including non‑operating gains, third‑quarter net profit after tax was NT$61 million, or EPS NT$0.29.

On the balance sheet, the company’s financial structure remains sound. As of the end of Q3, cash and financial assets were about NT$7.109 billion, accounting for more than 50% of total assets, indicating ample liquidity. Inventory rose 18.2% from the prior quarter as the company adjusted stock levels to mitigate supply‑chain uncertainties. Shareholders’ equity increased 0.9% quarter‑over‑quarter, with book value per share rising from NT$40.96 to NT$41.33.

Looking to Q4, Dun Tai said that shortages of raw‑material supplies, rising production costs, a persistently weak consumer‑electronics market, and uncertain demand conditions in mainland China are all dampening end‑market recovery momentum, leading brand customers to adopt a cautious pull‑in approach. Shipments and revenue are expected to keep declining, but the rollout of high‑end products and an optimized product mix should help gross margins continue to improve.

Regarding AMOLED display driver ICs, Dun Tai noted that after years of technical development it has earned certifications from multiple major brand customers and expects shipments to grow each quarter, reaching a monthly million‑unit scale by year‑end. Benefiting from the higher product gross margin, this should further boost the company’s revenue and profitability.

In the AMOLED touch‑panel arena, Dun Tai successfully launched the industry’s first single‑chip solution that supports up to a 21‑inch flexible screen for automotive touch ICs. Using a dual‑chip cascade architecture, it can also handle large screens up to 35 inches. The product has passed AEC‑Q100 automotive qualification and demonstrates a leading edge in high‑end automotive touch solutions. It has recently been integrated into Li Auto’s premium MEGA model, paired with a 21‑inch panel for a rear‑compartment 4K entertainment screen, marking a key milestone for Dun Tai in large‑size AMOLED touch and injecting new momentum into its automotive business.

In new‑technology development, the company has created the world‑leading Fortis Touch waterproof touch technology, overcoming the traditional issue of false touches or operation failure on touch screens under water or heavy rain. This innovation solves long‑standing pain points for outdoor‑use products such as wearables, smartphones, industrial controls, charging stations, and two‑wheel vehicle markets. Since its launch, it has attracted strong market attention and enthusiastic customer feedback, and the company plans to actively promote its adoption to open new growth opportunities.

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉旺季+油價創半年新高激勵營收年增6成 南亞再寫55個月新高
paras: 台塑(1301-TW)四寶今(6)日公告上(10)月營收，受惠金九銀十旺季加持，包括台塑、南亞(1303-TW)、台化(1326-TW)均達年月雙增，台塑化(6505-TW)則受戰事影響油價維持高檔，加上煉營業額年增94.8%，單月年增76%為四寶中最佳，集團總營收為1,639億元，月減1.8%、年增62.5%。南亞因AI伺服器持續旺盛，電子材料營收超過六成，成長力道強勁，單月營收再寫近55個月新高。
南亞表示，受電子材料營收占比突破6成，成長力道強勁，且今年AI伺服器算力及功耗持續飆升，硬體發展由購置個別機櫃或機櫃組群之模式，轉為打造十億瓦級的超大型資料中心，在各大雲端巨頭的鉅額投資及全速建設下，供需缺口進一步放大。
南亞提及，在高速傳輸、超低損耗要求下，目前電路板相關材料，步入持續性的供不應求，致電子材料連續漲價超過一年，現階段漲勢未歇，加上化工產品也因原料價格上升，使產品售價及營收上揚。
台塑10月營收為155.84億元、月增3.8%、年增16.2%，前10月累計1,491.28億元、年增1%。台塑指出，由於中東衝突升溫，市場擔憂原油供應中斷，布蘭特原油期貨價格持續上漲下，單月累計漲幅達13.6％，也推升乙、丙烯價格攀升，公司也反應成本，調漲主要產品售價，平均價格較9月上漲，幅度介於3-7％。
台化則表示，受惠美伊衝突後情勢反覆拉扯，原油供給受限及市場擔憂情緒等因素大幅推升油價，連帶影響石化塑膠產品行情跟漲，10月營收為358.32億元、月增17.3%、年增61.8%，前10月累計2,999.61億元、年增22.8%。
台塑化10月原油煉製量13,453千桶(434千桶/日)，比去年同期增加2,835千桶，主要係去(2025)年重油加氫脫硫(RDS#2)及重油媒裂(RCC#2)全月執行定檢，加上煉油營業額年增94.8%、烯烴營業額年增52.1%。

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉台塑、南亞估Q4業績優於Q3 南亞電子材料維持「量增、價漲」
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics' Four-Product Business Beats Q3; Nan Ya Electronics Materials Maintains "Higher Volume, Higher Prices"
paras: 台塑(1301-TW)四寶今(6)日公告10月營收及未來展望，台塑受惠於年底前「金九銀十」旺季及感恩節加持，雖在美國選舉變天、油價難以預期走勢下，第4季優於第3季；南亞(1303-TW)則認為在AI高階材料第4季將在「量增、價漲」的貢獻下看好11月、第4季業績優於前季。
台塑四寶上(10)月營收揭曉，台塑、南亞(1303-TW)、台化(1323-TW)皆繳出年月雙增，南亞單月更創近55個月新高。
台塑指出，第4季因適逢感恩節、聖誕節及中國網購等各種民生消費需求，為PE/PP包裝材、EVA鞋材、PP玩具及家電用品等傳統需求旺季，皆有利台塑產品銷售，加上中國持續推出刺激經濟措施，可望帶動石化產品需求增加。
此外，台塑強調，中東衝突未歇，原油及原料乙、丙烯維持高檔下，也支撐石化產品行情，本公司開工率及產銷量比第3季提高，預估第4季營業額比第3季成長。
南亞表示，11月及第四季合併營收將持續攀升，主要仍受惠於各項電子材料及載板等需求暢旺，價量齊揚，隨著AI應用推進，硬體發展對於電子材料需求更為強勁，南亞電子材料及南電(8046-TW)產能規模及技術能力的優勢將持續發威，受惠電子材料市場暢旺，將帶動中高階材料銷售、營收成長。
台化則認為，在11月5日民主黨贏得期中選舉、以色列國會變天下，中東衝突不太可能進一步升溫，油價將隨即反應，台化既有的原料及成品庫存，短期會有跌價損失，權益法收入也會受到影響，但公司一向採取低庫存操作，庫存損失可控，在上游原料跌價，公司將謹慎採購，將衝擊降至最低。
至於油價走勢預期，台塑化(6505-TW)強調，在美國大選共和黨慘敗下，將意味美國國會將拒絕為戰爭提供後續的軍事經費，致11月油價大幅下滑；汽油受惠於輕油供給緊縮，輕油價差持續強勢，維持整體輕質油品利差穩健，整體煉油製毛利依然位於高檔。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics (1301-TW) announced its October revenue and outlook today (the 6th). Benefiting from the "golden September, silver October" peak season and Thanksgiving, Formosa posted a stronger Q4 than Q3 despite the U.S. election shake‑up and uncertain oil prices. Nan Ya (1303-TW) expects its Q4 performance to improve over the prior quarter, driven by higher volume and higher prices in AI‑related advanced electronic materials.

Formosa's four‑product segment revealed October revenue, with Formosa, Nan Ya (1303-TW) and Formosa Chemical (1323-TW) all delivering double‑digit year‑over‑year growth, and Nan Ya achieving its highest monthly revenue in about 55 months.

Formosa noted that Q4 coincides with Thanksgiving, Christmas and Chinese e‑commerce demand, creating a traditional peak season for PE/PP packaging, EVA shoe material, PP toys and home‑appliance goods, all of which boost sales of its products. In addition, continued stimulus measures in China are expected to lift demand for petrochemical products.

Formosa also emphasized that, although the Middle‑East conflict persists and crude oil and feedstock ethylene and propylene remain at high levels, these factors support petrochemical pricing. The company's operating rate and production‑sales volume are higher than in Q3, and it forecasts Q4 revenue to grow versus Q3.

Nan Ya said that combined revenue for November and Q4 will keep rising, mainly due to strong demand for various electronic materials and substrates, with both price and volume increasing. As AI applications advance, hardware development further strengthens demand for electronic materials. Nan Ya's electronic‑material and Nan Dian (8046‑TW) capacity and technology advantages will continue to shine, driving mid‑to‑high‑end material sales and revenue growth.

Formosa Chemical stated that after the Democrats win the November 5 mid‑term elections and Israel’s parliament changes, the Middle‑East conflict is unlikely to intensify, and oil prices will adjust accordingly. Existing raw‑material and finished‑goods inventories will incur short‑term price‑losses, and equity‑method income will be affected, but the company’s low‑inventory strategy keeps losses manageable. With upstream raw‑material price declines, the firm will purchase cautiously to minimize impact.

Regarding oil‑price outlook, Formosa Chemical (6505‑TW) stressed that the Republican defeat in the U.S. election will likely lead Congress to refuse further war‑related military funding, causing a sharp drop in oil prices in November. Gasoline will benefit from tighter light‑oil supply, keeping the light‑oil price spread strong and maintaining robust margins for light‑product refining, so overall refining gross margins remain high.

輝達(NVDA-US)盤前上漲3.6%，超微(AMD-US)、英特爾(INTC-US)、博通(AVGO-US)與美光(MU-US)漲幅介於5%至8.3%。CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)等雲端運算業者，以及資料中心與電力設備相關股票也出現反彈。
這波回升發生在美股5日急跌之後，標普500成分股市值單日蒸發近3兆美元，那斯達克指數創19個月最大單日跌幅並進入修正區間。民主黨在期中選舉勝出，尤其在部分資料中心重鎮取得州級選舉勝利，讓投資人擔心審查趨嚴將拖慢AI基礎建設進度。

paras_en: On November 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – After a sharp pull‑back in US tech stocks, the AI chip sector steadied in pre‑market trading. Nasdaq‑100 futures rose 1.48%, S&P 500 futures gained 0.39%, while Dow futures remained down 0.66%, indicating that the rebound was concentrated in the heavily‑slumped tech shares from the previous session.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) was up 3.6% in pre‑market trading, while AMD (AMD‑US), Intel (INTC‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Micron (MU‑US) posted gains ranging from 5% to 8.3%. The recovery comes after a steep drop on the 5th, during which S&P 500 component market capitalisation evaporated nearly $3 trillion in a single day and the Nasdaq index recorded its biggest one‑day decline in 19 months, entering a correction zone. Democrats won the mid‑term elections, securing state‑level victories in several data‑center strongholds, prompting investors to worry that tighter regulatory scrutiny could slow AI infrastructure development.

The market now looks ahead to the US October employment report to gauge labour‑market conditions and interest‑rate direction. On the stock side, Atlassian (TEAM‑US) fell 15.6% in pre‑market trading after releasing its quarterly earnings, while Airbnb (ABNB‑US) raised its 2026 full‑year revenue growth outlook, sending the share price up 12.1%.

items.title: Microchip訂單強卻卡產能AI排擠封測供給、毛利率展望承壓
items.title_en: Microchip Orders Strong Yet AI Crowds Out Foundry and Test Capacity, Pressuring Gross Margin Outlook
paras: 2026年11月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 微控制器與類比晶片大廠Microchip Technology(MCHP-US)訂單持續成長，供應瓶頸卻開始壓抑出貨。公司在5日法說會指出，AI需求擠壓晶圓代工與封測產能，部分高毛利產品無法按客戶要求交貨，預估截至12月的季度調整後毛利率降至64%至65%，低於上一季的66.5%。
Microchip截至9月30日的2027會計年度第二季營收為16.22億美元，年增42.2%、季增9.2%；工業與資料中心業務營收分別年增50.3%及55.7%，是主要成長來源。當季接單出貨比明顯高於1，進入12月季時的在手訂單也高於前一季，顯示短期挑戰主要在交付能力。
執行長Steve Sanghi表示，多數標準產品過去交期約4至8週，如今不同產品已拉長至6至32週。部分封測供應商將產能轉向AI客戶，Microchip因而將部分製程移回內部，或改向其他封測廠生產；但重新認證與建置需要時間，部分新增產能預計到2027年3月季、6月季才陸續到位。即使晶圓由自家工廠生產，後段封裝與測試仍可能受限。
公司預估12月季營收為15.73億至16.38億美元，中值季減約1%、年增約35.4%。比較基期則受到一次性項目影響：9月季有約5,300萬美元來自較高專利授權收入、通路庫存漲價調整及長期客戶合約，12月季不再重複。這些項目的毛利率均為100%，加上高毛利產品交付延後及內部稼動率低於原先規劃，共同壓抑下一季毛利率。
資料中心仍有新產品成長動能。Microchip的PCIe Gen6交換器與重定時器設計導入案，已由6月底12項、9月底19項增至法說會當日24項，公司預期2027年逐步帶動營收。不過，Sanghi也提醒，若資料中心投資放緩，個別專案量產後的出貨量仍可能低於原先期待；設計導入並不等於所有需求已經實現。
成本端也有壓力。管理層表示，主要晶圓代工與封測供應商預計2027年1月再度調價，Microchip目前傾向先吸收成本，尚未打算在8月漲價後立即對客戶再調價。公司維持長期調整後毛利率65%的目標，後續獲利改善仍取決於供應瓶頸緩解、產品組合與成本變化。

paras_en: On November 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Microchip Technology (MCHP-US), a major maker of microcontrollers and analog chips, continues to see growing orders, but supply bottlenecks are beginning to curb shipments. At its November 5 earnings call, the company said AI demand is squeezing wafer‑foundry and test‑and‑pack capacity, preventing some high‑margin products from being delivered on customer schedules. It now expects adjusted gross margin for the quarter ending December to fall to 64%‑65%, down from 66.5% in the prior quarter.

Microchip reported second‑quarter revenue of $1.622 billion for its fiscal 2027 year ending September 30, up 42.2% year‑over‑year and 9.2% sequentially. Industrial and data‑center segments grew 50.3% and 55.7% year‑over‑year, respectively, driving the bulk of the growth. The order‑to‑shipment ratio was well above 1, and the backlog entering the December quarter also exceeded the prior quarter, indicating that short‑term challenges are mainly on the delivery side.

CEO Steve Sanghi said most standard products previously shipped in about 4‑8 weeks, but lead times have now stretched to 6‑32 weeks depending on the product. Some test‑and‑pack providers are shifting capacity to AI customers, prompting Microchip to bring certain processes back in‑house or move them to other test houses; however, re‑qualification and ramp‑up take time, with the new capacity expected to come online gradually in the March and June 2027 quarters. Even if wafers are produced internally, downstream packaging and testing may still be constrained.

The company forecasts December‑quarter revenue of $1.573 billion to $1.638 billion, a midpoint roughly 1% lower sequentially but about 35.4% higher year‑over‑year. The base period was boosted by one‑off items: the September quarter included roughly $53 million of higher patent‑licensing revenue, channel‑inventory price adjustments and long‑term customer contracts that will not recur in December. Those items carried a 100% gross margin, and together with delayed delivery of high‑margin products and lower‑than‑planned internal utilization, they suppress the next quarter’s margin.

Data‑center demand still has growth momentum. Microchip’s PCIe Gen6 switch and retimer design‑in projects grew from 12 at the end of June and 19 at the end of September to 24 by the day of the earnings call, and the company expects these to gradually drive revenue throughout 2027. However, Sanghi cautioned that if data‑center investment slows, shipment volumes after individual projects reach mass production could still fall short of original expectations; design‑in does not equal that all demand is realized.

Cost pressures also remain. Management noted that major wafer‑foundry and test‑and‑pack suppliers are expected to raise prices again in January 2027, and Microchip currently prefers to absorb the cost rather than pass it on immediately after its August price increase. The company maintains its long‑term adjusted gross‑margin target of 65%, with future profit improvement dependent on easing supply bottlenecks, product mix and cost dynamics.

items.title: 通膨壓力有望緩解！美10月非農就業料將反彈至6.5萬人　時薪增幅四年來首跌破3%
items.title_en: Inflation Pressure Expected to Ease! October U.S. Nonfarm Payrolls Forecast to Rebound to 65,000, Hourly Wage Growth Falls Below 3% for First Time in Four Years
paras: 美國勞工部今(6)日晚間將公佈10月非農就業數據，市場預期新增就業人數將反彈至6.5萬人，遠高於9月受假期干擾的2.9萬，但專家警告季節性調整因素不利，數據仍有遜於預期風險，失業率則預計維持於4.2%不變，或微降至4.1%。
儘管美國勞動市場裁員率處歷史低點，但低失業率背後是勞動供給實質萎縮。嚴厲移民政策與退休潮導致維持美國經濟擴張的每月盈虧平衡點，從2024年的15萬人驟降至4萬人，目前月均6.8萬人的增幅已足夠。
薪資放緩程度則更受關注。10月平均時薪年增率料將下降至2.9%，為2021年5月以來首度跌破3%。
分析師指出，就業市場未對薪資構成上行壓力，雖有助抑制通膨，但美國家庭9月實質可支配所得已下滑，青年求職難度激增。
值得注意的是，美國今年第三季GDP年化成長率高達3.4%，但就業成長明顯落後。企業因AI技術應用及中東衝突推高能源成本，轉向「輕就業」擴張模式，傾向依賴現有員工，而非大舉招募。這種經濟焦慮也反映在政壇，成為民主黨在期中選擊敗共和黨的關鍵因素。
Fed上星期維持利率於3.75%至4%不變。雖然市場仍預期下月可能升息，但溫和的薪資數據或限制明年升息次數。下週二(10日)公佈的CPI數據將提供關鍵政策線索。
桑坦德銀行經濟學家認為，當前勞動力市場「既不太熱也不太冷」，Fed無須過度擔憂。
paras_en: The U.S. Labor Department will release October nonfarm payroll data this evening (the 6th). The market expects job gains to rebound to 65,000, far above September’s 29,000, which was distorted by holidays, though experts warn that seasonal adjustments are unfavorable and the figures could still fall short of expectations. The unemployment rate is projected to stay at 4.2% or slip slightly to 4.1%.

Even though the U.S. labor market’s layoff rate is at a historic low, the low unemployment rate masks a real contraction in labor supply. Tough immigration policies and a wave of retirements have driven the monthly breakeven point for sustaining U.S. economic expansion down sharply—from 150,000 in 2024 to 40,000—so the current average monthly gain of 68,000 is already sufficient.
Wage slowdown is drawing even more attention. The average hourly earnings growth rate for October is expected to fall to 2.9%, the first time it has dropped below 3% since May 2021.

Analysts note that the employment market is not putting upward pressure on wages, which helps curb inflation, but U.S. households’ real disposable income fell in September and job prospects for young people have deteriorated sharply.

It is worth noting that U.S. GDP grew at an annualized 3.4% in the third quarter, yet employment growth lagged noticeably. Companies, facing higher energy costs from AI adoption and Middle‑East conflicts, are shifting to a “light‑employment” expansion model, relying more on existing staff rather than large hiring drives. This economic anxiety is also reflected in politics, becoming a key factor for Democrats defeating Republicans in the mid‑term elections.

The Fed kept its policy rate unchanged last week at a range of 3.75%‑4.0%. Although markets still anticipate a possible rate hike next month, the modest wage data may limit the number of hikes next year. The CPI report due next Tuesday (the 10th) will provide crucial policy guidance.
Santander Bank economists believe the current labor market is “neither too hot nor too cold,” so the Fed need not be overly concerned.

paras: 全球矚目的2026年美國期中選舉落下帷幕，執政的共和黨遭遇毀滅性打擊，民主黨一舉奪回國會參眾兩院控制權。面對這場被政壇形容為「藍色海嘯」的選戰結果，德州共和黨聯邦參議員克魯茲(Ted Cruz)在選後坦言，這絕非一次普通的敗選，而是一場「水門案等級的全面唾棄」與「當頭棒喝」。
共和黨不僅在全美失去了8至10個參議院席次，連南卡羅來納州、堪薩斯州乃至傳統紅州堡壘德州等地的選情亦紛紛告急或失守。克魯茲認同，這場政治大地震背後的最核心推手，正是基層民眾對持續惡化的貧富差距與沉重生活負擔所爆發的深層怒火。
對於共和黨遭遇慘敗的根源，《BBC》專題分析認為，共和黨失利的五大核心因素包括：生活成本飆升、美伊戰爭不得人心、川普個人支持度低迷拖累選情、民主黨競選訊息集中一致，以及西班牙裔與黑人選民的回流。

每天20萬美國人「賣血換日常雜貨」

報導特別引述選民調查指出，高達79%的選民表示通膨對生活造成嚴重影響。儘管官方宏觀經濟數據頻頻宣示股市創新高與企業獲利亮眼，但基層庶民感受到的卻是近乎窒息的生存壓力。受到關稅政策與伊朗戰爭推高能源價格影響，全美通膨率飆升至3.7%，柴油價格更是暴漲至每加侖6美元以上，帶動整體物價全面飛漲。
令人震撼的嚴峻社會現實是，基層家庭為了維持溫飽，已被迫採取極端的生存手段。
根據統計，2026年全美付費捐血漿次數突破7,500萬次創下歷史新高，克魯茲強調，這意味著每天有多達20萬名美國人手臂上插著針頭，僅為了換取微薄的現金報酬來支付日常雜貨費用。
此外，高達29%的美國人今年被迫使用「先買後付」(BNPL)微型貸款來購買基本食品雜貨，比例較兩年前翻倍；廉價肉類替代品SPAM午餐肉罐頭全年銷售量突破1.13億罐，幾乎追平第二次世界大戰期間的總銷量。當民眾連購買日用品都需要分期付款甚至賣血換錢，政策的失能已將基層逼入絕境。

頂層1%與底層50%的財富鴻溝

民怨爆發的深層根源，在於美國貧富分化已惡化為極端固化的「K型經濟」結構。美國人口普查局最新數據顯示，2025年全美按官方標準共有約3,450萬人生活在貧困線以下，貧困率高達10.2%。富裕階層與普通勞工在財富積累上走向完全相反的兩極。
統計指出，美國頂層1%的富豪掌握了全國高達32%的財富，創下歷史新高；相反地，底層50%的全美家庭資產加總，僅占全國總財富的2.5%。在資產性財富方面，差距更令人瞠目結舌——最富有10%的家庭持有全美超過87%的股票與共同基金，而底層50%的家庭合計僅持有約1%。
這意味著高科技股與人工智慧(AI)浪潮所推動的股市盛宴，完全只是極少數頂層富豪的財富遊戲，過半數的普通美國人完全享受不到經濟成長的紅利，反而必須承受高房貸利率與高租金的擠壓。

「劫貧濟富」的政策矛盾與政經怒火

民怨爆發的深層根源，在於美國貧富分化已固化為嚴重的「K型經濟」。依據美國人口普查局(U.S. Census Bureau)的官方數據，2025年全美貧困率達10.2%，約有3,450萬人生活在貧困線以下。
聯準會的統計則顯示，全美頂層1%富豪掌握了32%的總財富，創歷史新高；相反地，底層50%家庭的財富總和僅占全國2.5%。在股市資產方面，最富有10%的家庭持有超過87%的股票，而底層50%家庭僅持有約1%，顯見股市繁榮與半數民眾完全無關。
針對政策與利益分配問題，《美聯社》調查與彭博等商業媒體估算指出，川普第二任期的政策被批評為「減稅讓富豪獲利，卻收緊底層福利」。與基層賣血求生形成強烈對比的是，川普個人淨資產在重返白宮後從23億美元大幅暴增至65億至76億美元，其家族更透過推動「川普幣」($TRUMP)等加密貨幣事業獲利數億美元。
paras_en: The highly anticipated 2026 U.S. midterm election has concluded, delivering a devastating blow to the ruling Republican Party as the Democrats seize control of both chambers of Congress. In what the political arena has dubbed a “blue wave,” Texas Republican Senator Ted Cruz admitted after the election that this was not a mere defeat but a “Watergate‑level repudiation” and a “blow‑to‑the‑head.”

The Republicans lost between eight and ten Senate seats nationwide, and even traditional red‑state strongholds such as South Carolina, Kansas, and Texas saw their political fortunes crumble. Cruz agreed that the core driver of this seismic political shift was grassroots anger over the worsening income gap and heavy living costs.

A BBC special analysis identified five key factors behind the Republican loss: soaring living costs, unpopular U.S.–Iran war, Trump’s low personal approval, a unified Democratic campaign message, and a return of Hispanic and Black voters.

Every day, 200,000 Americans sell blood for basic groceries. Polls show that 79% of voters say inflation severely impacts their lives. Despite official macro data touting record stock market highs and corporate profits, ordinary people feel suffocating survival pressure. Tariff policies and the Iran war have pushed national inflation to 3.7%, with diesel prices spiking above $6 per gallon, driving overall price inflation.
The stark social reality is that grassroots families are forced to adopt extreme survival tactics to keep food on the table.

In 2026, paid plasma donations in the U.S. exceeded 75 million, a record high. Cruz emphasized that this means up to 200,000 Americans are literally having needles inserted into their arms daily to earn a modest cash reward for groceries.

Additionally, 29% of Americans this year have been forced to use “buy now, pay later” (BNPL) micro‑loans to purchase basic groceries, a figure that has doubled since two years ago. Cheap meat substitutes like SPAM canned luncheon meat sold over 113 million cans, nearly matching World War II‑era totals. When people need installment payments or blood sales just to buy daily necessities, policy failure has driven the grassroots to desperation.

The wealth gap between the top 1% and the bottom 50% is widening. The U.S. Census Bureau’s latest data shows that in 2025, about 34.5 million people lived below the poverty line, a poverty rate of 10.2%. The affluent and ordinary workers are moving toward opposite extremes in wealth accumulation.

Statistics reveal that the top 1% of U.S. wealth holders control 32% of national wealth, a record high, while the bottom 50% of households hold only 2.5% of total wealth. In terms of asset wealth, the top 10% hold over 87% of U.S. stocks and mutual funds, whereas the bottom 50% hold only about 1%.

This means that the stock market boom driven by high‑tech and AI is a game for a tiny elite, while more than half of ordinary Americans receive no benefit from economic growth and instead bear the burden of high mortgage rates and rent.

The policy contradiction of “rich‑rich, poor‑poor” fuels political anger. The deep root of the discontent is the entrenched K‑shaped economy. According to U.S. Census Bureau data, the poverty rate in 2025 was 10.2%, with 34.5 million people living below the poverty line.

Federal Reserve statistics show that the top 1% of U.S. wealth holders control 32% of total wealth, a record high, while the bottom 50% of households hold only 2.5% of national wealth. In stock market assets, the top 10% hold over 87% of stocks, while the bottom 50% hold only about 1%, illustrating that stock market prosperity is unrelated to half the population.

According to AP and Bloomberg estimates, Trump’s second‑term policies are criticized for “tax cuts that benefit the wealthy while tightening welfare for the poor.” In stark contrast to grassroots blood‑selling survival, Trump’s personal net worth surged from $2.3 billion to $6.5–7.6 billion after returning to the White House, and his family profited billions through crypto ventures such as the $TRUMP token.

items.title: 美股暴跌與監管疑慮夾擊 Anthropic IPO 1.5兆美元估值恐遭大幅砍價
items.title_en: US Stocks Plunge and Regulatory Concerns Hit Anthropic IPO; $1.5 Trillion Valuation Feared to Be Slashed
paras: 人工智慧巨頭 Anthropic 原定於感恩節前一周在那斯達克掛牌上市，預計募集高達 1,000 億美元資金，並挑戰約 1.5 兆美元的創紀錄估值。然而，隨著美股近日爆發劇烈拋售，這一目標正遭嚴厲挑戰。
那斯達克指數周四(5日)單日市值暴跌約 2.5 兆美元，加上美國期中選舉後政治局勢變化引發的 AI 監管加嚴與部分地區資料中心建設暫緩疑慮，Anthropic 上市計畫正面臨沉重的估值修正壓力。
據《華爾街日報》引述知情人士報導，三名計畫參與本次上市案的大型機構投資者明確指出，Anthropic 的目標估值勢必下調。其中一名投資者認為，合理估值可能更接近 1 兆美元；另一名投資者則分析，在近期股市暴跌中遭受損失的基金經理人恐難再冒險承擔高估值 AI 資產，公司可能迫於市場氛圍推遲上市時程，或將募資規模縮減至 800 億美元。
除了投資機構的戒心，知名投資人《大賣空》(The Big Short)原型貝瑞(Michael Burry)在其文章中提出強烈質疑，指出 Anthropic 第三季銷售與行銷費用占營收比重已從首季的 22% 及第二季的 19% 降至 14%，質疑其雲端合作夥伴是否在 IPO 前夕協助美化財務數據。
資產管理巨擘Blackstone Inc.發布警告，指出 Anthropic 上市後可能難以獲得投資級信用評級，這將顯著推升其未來的借貸成本。
儘管遭遇市場亂流，Anthropic 仍擁有相當的財務彈性。截至 9 月 30 日，公司持有高達 1,466 億美元的現金儲備，且 10 月年化營收已突破 800 億美元。公司高層與顧問團隊預計於近期召開會議重新評估上市計畫。
與此同時，私人市場已出現冷卻跡象，競爭對手 OpenAI 在最新一輪融資中原本目標募集 300 億美元，最終僅取得 110 億美元，估值為 1.25 兆美元。
paras_en: AI giant Anthropic had planned to list on Nasdaq a week before Thanksgiving, aiming to raise up to $100 billion and target a record‑breaking valuation of about $1.5 trillion. However, the recent violent sell‑off in US equities is putting that goal under severe pressure.

The Nasdaq index saw its market cap tumble by roughly $2.5 trillion on Thursday (the 5th), and, combined with heightened AI regulation after the US mid‑term elections and lingering doubts about data‑center construction in some regions, Anthropic’s IPO is facing heavy valuation‑adjustment pressure.

According to a Wall Street Journal report citing insiders, three large institutional investors slated to participate in the offering said Anthropic’s target valuation will inevitably be cut. One investor believes a fair value may be closer to $1 trillion; another analyst warned that fund managers who suffered losses in the recent market crash are unlikely to risk backing an over‑valued AI asset, suggesting the company might delay its listing or trim the raise to $80 billion.

Beyond institutional caution, prominent investor Michael Burry – the real‑life inspiration for “The Big Short” – raised strong doubts in an article, noting that Anthropic’s Q3 sales and marketing expenses fell from 22% of revenue in Q1 and 19% in Q2 to 14%, and questioning whether its cloud partners are helping to polish the financials ahead of the IPO.

Asset‑management giant Blackstone Inc. issued a warning that Anthropic may struggle to obtain an investment‑grade credit rating after going public, which would significantly raise its future borrowing costs.

Despite the market turbulence, Anthropic still has considerable financial flexibility. As of September 30, the company held $146.6 billion in cash, and its annualized revenue for October has already topped $80 billion. Senior executives and advisors plan to meet soon to reassess the listing plan.

At the same time, the private‑market climate is cooling. Competitor OpenAI, which originally aimed to raise $30 billion in its latest round, ended up securing only $11 billion, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion.

items.title: 15美元轉走25億美元！幣安遇駭細節曝光：駭客利用新功能  三分半完成「完美犯罪」
items.title_en: $15 Network Fee Used to Transfer $2.5 Billion! Binance Hack Details Revealed: Hackers Exploited New Feature, Completed “Perfect Crime” in Three and a Half Minutes
paras: 知名加密貨幣交易所幣安(Binance)遭駭案浮現驚人細節，駭客僅花約15美元網路費，就利用以太坊新機制一口氣轉走約25億美元被盜資產，佔總損失63億美元的近四成。該機制讓錢包可像「自動扣款」般預先授權程式批量操作，免去逐筆簽名。
根據區塊鏈紀錄，這群駭客把原本用來提升錢包便利性的「代理授權」功能武器化。安全公司Blockaid指出，攻擊者先支付約15美元Gas費，建立一項可讓外部程式代為操作錢包的授權，隨後在單筆交易中，將幣安14熱錢包內資產一次性清空。
入侵路徑則是典型的「高級社交工程」。幣安公佈時間線指出，駭客以虛假招聘職缺誘騙工程師下載惡意程式，結合受駭裝置、AI技術與多階段滲透，最終鎖定處理客戶提款的熱錢包，這個「在線收銀機」平日存放大量以太幣、穩定幣及數十種代幣。
關鍵在於以太坊去年5月啟用的EIP-7702升級。Tibane Labs分析指出，駭客取得的程式碼功能極為簡單。所有者一下令便把錢包資產全數轉出，在UTC時間上周四(10月29日)晚間約20:20建立授權，三分半後發動轉移，25億美元瞬間流向攻擊者指定地址。
被盜資產包含16萬7464枚以太幣，以及Tether(USDT)等60餘種代幣，其中USDT面值高達16億美元。傳統多幣種轉移需逐筆交易、逐一簽章，極易被風控攔截，但EIP-7702卻提供「打包執行」捷徑，讓監控窗口被壓縮到數分鐘內。
業內人士警告，在提升用戶體驗的同時，錢包抽象化與帳戶抽象升級也正成為新一代鏈上攻擊向量。當「授權即權限」成為常態，交易所熱錢包的授權邊界管理，將是下一階段安全防禦的核心戰場。
paras_en: A high‑profile hack of the cryptocurrency exchange Binance has revealed shocking details: the attackers spent only about $15 in network fees to exploit a new Ethereum mechanism and siphon roughly $2.5 billion of stolen assets, accounting for nearly 40 % of the total $6.3 billion loss. The mechanism lets wallets pre‑authorize programs to batch‑process transactions, eliminating the need for individual signatures.

Blockchain records show the hackers weaponized the “delegated authorization” feature that was originally intended to improve wallet convenience. Security firm Blockaid said the attackers first paid about $15 in gas to create an authorization that allows an external program to act on the wallet, then emptied Binance’s hot wallet #14 in a single transaction.

The intrusion path was a classic “advanced social engineering” attack. Binance’s timeline indicates the hackers lured engineers with a fake job posting, prompting them to download malware. Combined with compromised devices, AI tools and multi‑stage infiltration, the attackers ultimately targeted the hot wallet that processes customer withdrawals – an “online cash register” that normally holds large amounts of ETH, stablecoins and dozens of other tokens.

The key was the Ethereum upgrade EIP‑7702, launched in May last year. Tibane Labs analysis notes the code the hackers obtained was extremely simple: the owner could issue a single command to move all wallet assets. The authorization was created around 20:20 UTC on Thursday, Oct 29, and three and a half minutes later the $2.5 billion was transferred to addresses controlled by the attackers.

The stolen assets include 167,464 ETH and more than 60 other tokens such as Tether (USDT), with USDT alone valued at $1.6 billion. Traditional multi‑token transfers require individual transactions and signatures, making them easy for risk‑control systems to block, but EIP‑7702 provides a “batch execution” shortcut that compresses the monitoring window to just a few minutes.

Industry insiders warn that while user‑experience improvements are valuable, wallet abstraction and account abstraction upgrades are becoming a new generation of on‑chain attack vectors. As “authorization equals permission” becomes the norm, managing the authorization boundaries of exchange hot wallets will be the core battlefield for the next phase of security defenses.

items.title: 遭美國國會盯上！黃仁勳捲共諜案 眾議員要求11/18赴國會說明 輝達發聲明自清
paras: 《紐約時報》日前披露，一名與輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳往來的中國籍女性高階主管黃樂(Alice Huang)，遭美國認定為中國情報人員，事件引發美國政界關注，美國眾議院三名共和黨委員會主席已要求黃仁勳11月18日出席閉門簡報會，說明兩人關係。
根據《紐時》的調查報導，黃樂曾任新加坡資料中心商Megaspeed的高階主管，美國政府正在調查她是否涉嫌情報給中國政府，並協助把輝達的先進晶片轉運至中國。
《CNBC》報導，共和黨議員在周四(5日)公布一封致黃仁勳信函，信中寫道，他們希望了解黃仁勳與黃樂的互動情況，以及輝達「防範外國敵對勢力間諜活動的安全規範」。
信中說：「近期報導引發重大國安疑慮，涉及中華人民共和國(PRC)取得美國敏感技術與資訊的管道。」信中並未說明所指的是哪些報導。
這封信函由眾議院外交事務委員會主席Brian Mast、眾議院中國問題特別委員會主席John Moolenaar，以及眾議院情報常設特別委員會主席Rick Crawford共同簽署，三人均為共和黨籍。
他們邀請黃仁勳於11月18日出席閉門簡報會，而前一天、11月17日正是輝達公布第3季財報的日期。

川普約一年前已獲知情報 輝達未回應黃仁勳是否出席

美國總統川普本人與黃仁勳關係密切，並積極推動美國AI產業發展。根據《紐時》報導，川普約一年前就已獲知上述情報調查結果，但消息人士透露，川普「選擇不對這項資訊採取任何行動」。
輝達並未直接回應有關這封信函的報導，也未確認黃仁勳是否會出席議員提議的簡報會。
不過，輝達仍提供一份聲明，內容大致與先前回覆《紐時》的說法相同。發言人在信中透露，黃仁勳與黃樂的互動，與他和其他企業客戶高階主管的會面並無不同。
輝達發言人在聲明中說：「我們在當地的雲端客戶取得的是一般商業資訊，而非輝達敏感的商業機密，也完全不涉及任何與國安相關的資訊。」
信中說：「與客戶會面是執行長工作的一部分。黃仁勳每年都會與數千名客戶企業高階主管交談，我們相信，如果美國政府認為任何人對美國產業構成威脅，就會通知我們。」

items.title: 押注逾800億美元後踩煞車 微軟嚴審新雲端夥伴、退出部分資料中心案
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US) 對「新雲端」算力合作的龐大押注開始轉趨保守。面對資料中心交付延誤、工程故障與監管壓力，公司正加強審查第三方合作夥伴，退出部分高風險項目，並重新評估是否簽署新交易。
先前微軟對四家業者承諾的金額合計逾800億美元，如今執行風險浮現，也讓這條擴充算力的路線受到內部質疑。
逾800億美元押注 交付延誤打亂支出
《彭博》引述消息人士報導，微軟正加強監督Nebius Group N.V. Class (YNDX-US) 、IREN(IREN-US) 及Nscale的部分資料中心項目，退出其認為風險較高的開發案，內部也在討論是否繼續簽署新的新雲端交易。
微軟先前對Nscale的承諾金額最高達438億美元，對Nebius最高達194億美元，對CoreWeave超過100億美元，對IREN則約97億美元。
隨著合作案陸續面臨交付問題，這些大規模承諾也帶來成本與執行壓力。
這項態度轉變，在微軟最近的財報電話會議上已有跡可循。財務長胡德（Amy Hood）三度提到，第三方算力交付延遲正擾亂公司支出計畫。相關消息公布後，IREN與Nebius股價一度均下跌20%。
IREN工程接連出狀況 完工恐再延後
近期浮現的問題之一，是IREN在德州開發項目的布線故障。資料中心伺服器仰賴複雜的光纖網路互連，布線出錯可能直接影響整體交付進度。
該園區今年4月曾發生發電機起火事故，IREN又在8月揭露當地硬體交付延遲，工程問題持續累積。
消息人士表示，IREN與微軟管理層上週舉行會談，協商出修訂後的時程，項目完工時間可能因此延後數週，甚至數月。
IREN拒絕置評。微軟則表示，公司依據自身及客戶需求管理與基礎設施合作夥伴的關係，包括監控交付情況，並在狀況改變時調整計畫。
微軟強調，這是管理大型、複雜基礎設施項目時，正常且負責任的做法。
派員進駐工地 退出部分Nscale項目
為了掌握工程進度，微軟正增加現場監督。近幾個月，公司已派員進駐Nebius位於紐澤西州的項目，以及Nscale、IREN在德州的項目，確保設施依照微軟規格興建，並符合監管要求。
除了加強監督，微軟也開始退出其認為已不可行的項目。據報導，公司已退出Nscale多個開發案，並拒絕擴大雙方在德州的合作，相關算力後來由Figure AI接手。
微軟另外撤回一份意向書，不再計畫向Nscale租用其位於西維吉尼亞州的1.35吉瓦算力。這些動作顯示，微軟對部分合作案的調整，已從加強審查進一步走向退出。
接連失單 Nscale上市計畫承壓
Nscale面臨的挫折不只來自美國。《金融時報》引述消息人士報導，微軟年初已取消與Nscale英國艾塞克斯資料中心約30億美元的租約。
Nscale上半年淨損10億美元，營收僅1.41億美元，儘管其未履約合約總額仍達1,030億美元，接連失去微軟合作案，仍為公司帶來壓力。
Nscale原本正籌備首次公開發行（IPO），估值目標高達350億美元。董事會成員包括Meta前高層桑德伯格（Sheryl Sandberg），以及英國前副首相克萊格（Nick Clegg）。如今連續失單，也讓上市計畫面臨新的考驗。
監管與資金壓力升高 產業恐加速整併
新雲端產業同時面臨監管環境收緊。本週多名民主黨州長候選人勝選，這些候選人在競選期間，都將加強資料中心監管列為重要議題。
其中，德州候任州長希諾霍薩（Gina Hinojosa）主張，在建立更完善的監管制度前，應立即暫停資料中心開發。德州是多家新雲端業者的核心業務所在地，相關主張直接威脅當地開發計畫。
資金壓力也是產業隱憂。馬斯克先前曾表示，許多新雲端公司可能因難以籌足營運資金，如「小魚」般被淘汰。研究機構Gartner則預估，到2030年底，80%的新雲端服務商可能面臨整併或關閉。
微軟內部對這條路線的疑慮也並非始於近期。高階主管一直擔心，將部分業務外包可能助長潛在競爭對手，而新雲端業者建置、營運資料中心的經驗相對有限，也可能讓微軟承擔更高成本與執行風險。
隨著交付延遲與監管阻力浮現，這些疑慮正反映在更嚴格的審查與合作調整上。

items.title: 美國民主黨計劃對蘋果、Meta展開調查
items.title_en: U.S. Democrats Plan to Investigate Apple, Meta
paras: 美國民主黨準備將調查矛頭指向多家科技巨頭，蘋果(AAPL-US) 、Meta(META-US) 以及全球首富馬斯克旗下公司均被列入調查目標。
據《華盛頓郵報》6日（周五）報導，民主黨計劃針對科技企業多項業務和政策爭議展開調查，涉及馬斯克旗下AI聊天機器人Grok、蘋果應用商店中ICE追蹤應用，以及Meta與地方政府達成的資料中心協議。
具體來看，民主黨計劃調查美國總統川普在委內瑞拉軍事行動中使用Grok一事，重點涉及馬斯克旗下AI工具在相關行動中的使用情況。
蘋果也將面臨調查。民主黨計劃審查蘋果應用商店為何上架用於追蹤美國移民與海關執法局（ICE）執法人員的應用程式。
Meta則因其與地方政府簽署的資料中心協議成為調查目標。民主黨計劃審查Meta與地方政府達成的相關協議，關注資料中心項目具體安排。
paras_en: U.S. Democrats are preparing to target several tech giants, with Apple (AAPL-US), Meta (META-US) and companies owned by the world’s richest man, Elon Musk, all listed as investigation targets.

According to a Washington Post report on Friday the 6th, Democrats plan to launch investigations into multiple business and policy controversies involving tech firms, covering Musk’s AI chatbot Grok, an ICE-tracking app in Apple’s App Store, and a data‑center agreement between Meta and local governments.
Specifically, Democrats intend to probe President Trump’s use of Grok in the Venezuelan military operation, focusing on how Musk’s AI tool was employed in that action.
Apple will also face scrutiny. Democrats plan to examine why the App Store listed an application used to track U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers.
Meta is a target because of its data‑center agreements with local governments. Democrats will review those agreements, focusing on the specific arrangements of the data‑center projects.

items.title: 美股盤前／AI晶片股反彈那指期貨漲1.48%，輝達回升3.6%
items.title_en: US Stocks Pre‑Market: AI Chip Stocks Rebound, Nasdaq‑100 Futures Up 1.48%, Nvidia Gains 3.6%

輝達(NVDA-US)盤前上漲3.6%，超微(AMD-US)、英特爾(INTC-US)、博通(AVGO-US)與美光(MU-US)漲幅介於5%至8.3%。CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)等雲端運算業者，以及資料中心與電力設備相關股票也出現反彈。
這波回升發生在美股5日急跌之後，標普500成分股市值單日蒸發近3兆美元，那斯達克指數創19個月最大單日跌幅並進入修正區間。民主黨在期中選舉勝出，尤其在部分資料中心重鎮取得州級選舉勝利，讓投資人擔心審查趨嚴將拖慢AI基礎建設進度。
市場接下來關注美國10月就業報告，評估勞動市場與利率走向。個股方面，Atlassian(TEAM-US)公布季度財報後盤前下跌15.6%；Airbnb(ABNB-US)上修2026年全年營收成長預期，股價上漲12.1%。

paras_en: On November 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – After a sharp pull‑back in US tech stocks, the AI chip sector steadied in pre‑market trading. Democrats won the mid‑term elections, securing state‑level victories in several data‑center strongholds, prompting investors to worry that tighter regulatory scrutiny could slow AI infrastructure development.

The market now looks ahead to the US October employment report to gauge labour‑market conditions and interest‑rate direction. On the stock side, Atlassian (TEAM‑US) fell 15.6% in pre‑market trading after releasing its quarterly earnings, while Airbnb (ABNB‑US) raised its 2026 full‑year revenue growth outlook, sending the share price up 12.1%.

items.title: AI賣壓衝擊亞洲股市台灣啟動國安基金、南韓放寬融資規定穩市場
items.title_en: AI Selling Pressure Hits Asian Stock Markets; Taiwan Launches National Security Fund, South Korea Relaxes Margin Rules to Stabilize Market
paras: 2026年11月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球投資人重新評估AI基礎建設的投資前景，科技股賣壓延燒亞洲，台灣與南韓相繼祭出穩市措施。台灣國安基金6日決議授權視市況動用資金，南韓則宣布暫時放寬散戶融資擔保規定，降低股市急跌引發強制賣股的壓力。
台股6日盤中一度重挫3,738點，終場跌1,873點，收39,702點，跌幅4.51%。國安基金指出，11月2日至6日累計下跌5,510點、跌幅12.19%，距今年高點已回落20.55%。外資10月累計賣超9,943億元，11月截至6日再賣超5,244億元，資金撤出加重市場壓力。
國安基金6日下午2時30分召開第131次臨時委員會，認為台灣經濟基本面良好，但國際政經局勢高度不確定、短期市場信心明顯不足，因此授權執行秘書視情況動用資金執行市場安定任務，尚未公布實際買進時間或金額。市場另傳出，財政部當天上午已致電公股銀行高層，要求支持股市。
南韓股市當天也出現劇烈震盪，KOSPI指數盤中最多下跌8.8%，觸發熔斷暫停交易20分鐘，終場下跌6.02%。南韓政府宣布，自11月9日起的三個月內，暫時豁免證券商要求散戶融資維持相當於借款額140%擔保品的規定，希望減少投資人因擔保不足而被迫賣股。政府表示，若市場波動進一步加劇，將準備採取額外措施。
中國本週稍早也推出支持股市的資金措施。中國人民銀行自11月4日起，將股票回購、增持再貸款利率調降1碼至1%，並於11月3日進行1,000億元人民幣的互換操作，為證券、基金等機構購股提供融資。這些措施主要是降低企業與機構取得資金的成本，與政府直接進場買股的方式不同。
儘管各地陸續採取措施，投資人仍在評估AI資料中心建設是否會因監管、電力與地方審批而放慢。若實際建設進度延後，市場對晶片、伺服器及相關設備的需求預估，也可能隨之調整。

paras_en: On November 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Global investors are re‑evaluating the investment outlook for AI infrastructure, and tech‑stock selling pressure is spreading across Asia. Taiwan and South Korea have successively introduced market‑stabilising measures. Taiwan's National Security Fund resolved on the 6th to authorize the use of funds depending on market conditions, while South Korea announced a temporary relaxation of retail margin‑collateral requirements to reduce the pressure of forced stock sales caused by a sharp market decline.

During intraday trading on the 6th, the Taiwan stock index fell as much as 3,738 points, ending the session down 1,873 points at 39,702 points, a decline of 4.51%. The National Security Fund noted that from November 2 to 6 the index had dropped a cumulative 5,510 points, a 12.19% fall, representing a 20.55% retracement from this year’s peak. Foreign investors sold a net 994.3 billion TWD in October and a further net 524.4 billion TWD by November 6, intensifying the outflow pressure on the market.

At 2:30 p.m. on the 6th, the National Security Fund held its 131st emergency committee meeting. It concluded that Taiwan’s economic fundamentals remain sound, but the international political‑economic environment is highly uncertain and short‑term market confidence is clearly lacking. Accordingly, it authorized the executive secretary to deploy funds as needed to carry out market‑stability tasks, though the exact timing or amount of purchases has not been disclosed. Market sources also reported that the Ministry of Finance called senior officials of state‑owned banks that morning, urging them to support the equity market.

South Korea’s market also experienced extreme volatility that day. The KOSPI fell as much as 8.8% intraday, triggering a circuit‑breaker halt for 20 minutes, and closed down 6.02%. The South Korean government announced that, for a three‑month period starting November 9, it will temporarily waive the rule requiring retail investors to maintain collateral equal to 140% of their margin loan amount, hoping to reduce forced selling due to insufficient collateral. The government added that if market turbulence escalates further, additional measures will be prepared.

Earlier this week, China also rolled out funding measures to support its stock market. Starting November 4, the People’s Bank of China lowered the interest rate on stock‑repurchase and additional‑loan facilities by one basis point to 1%, and on November 3 conducted a 100 billion‑yuan swap operation to provide financing for securities firms, fund managers and other institutions to purchase shares. These steps aim mainly to lower the cost of capital for companies and institutions, differing from a direct government equity‑buying approach.

Despite the assorted interventions, investors continue to assess whether AI data‑center construction might slow due to regulatory, power‑supply or local‑approval constraints. If actual build‑out timelines are delayed, market forecasts for demand for chips, servers and related equipment could be revised accordingly.

items.title: Microchip訂單強卻卡產能AI排擠封測供給、毛利率展望承壓
items.title_en: Microchip Orders Strong Yet AI Crowds Out Foundry and Test Capacity, Pressuring Gross Margin Outlook
paras: 2026年11月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 微控制器與類比晶片大廠Microchip Technology(MCHP-US)訂單持續成長，供應瓶頸卻開始壓抑出貨。公司在5日法說會指出，AI需求擠壓晶圓代工與封測產能，部分高毛利產品無法按客戶要求交貨，預估截至12月的季度調整後毛利率降至64%至65%，低於上一季的66.5%。
Microchip截至9月30日的2027會計年度第二季營收為16.22億美元，年增42.2%、季增9.2%；工業與資料中心業務營收分別年增50.3%及55.7%，是主要成長來源。當季接單出貨比明顯高於1，進入12月季時的在手訂單也高於前一季，顯示短期挑戰主要在交付能力。
執行長Steve Sanghi表示，多數標準產品過去交期約4至8週，如今不同產品已拉長至6至32週。部分封測供應商將產能轉向AI客戶，Microchip因而將部分製程移回內部，或改向其他封測廠生產；但重新認證與建置需要時間，部分新增產能預計到2027年3月季、6月季才陸續到位。即使晶圓由自家工廠生產，後段封裝與測試仍可能受限。
公司預估12月季營收為15.73億至16.38億美元，中值季減約1%、年增約35.4%。比較基期則受到一次性項目影響：9月季有約5,300萬美元來自較高專利授權收入、通路庫存漲價調整及長期客戶合約，12月季不再重複。這些項目的毛利率均為100%，加上高毛利產品交付延後及內部稼動率低於原先規劃，共同壓抑下一季毛利率。
資料中心仍有新產品成長動能。Microchip的PCIe Gen6交換器與重定時器設計導入案，已由6月底12項、9月底19項增至法說會當日24項，公司預期2027年逐步帶動營收。不過，Sanghi也提醒，若資料中心投資放緩，個別專案量產後的出貨量仍可能低於原先期待；設計導入並不等於所有需求已經實現。
成本端也有壓力。管理層表示，主要晶圓代工與封測供應商預計2027年1月再度調價，Microchip目前傾向先吸收成本，尚未打算在8月漲價後立即對客戶再調價。公司維持長期調整後毛利率65%的目標，後續獲利改善仍取決於供應瓶頸緩解、產品組合與成本變化。

paras_en: On November 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Microchip Technology (MCHP-US), a major maker of microcontrollers and analog chips, continues to see growing orders, but supply bottlenecks are beginning to curb shipments. At its November 5 earnings call, the company said AI demand is squeezing wafer‑foundry and test‑and‑pack capacity, preventing some high‑margin products from being delivered on customer schedules. It now expects adjusted gross margin for the quarter ending December to fall to 64%‑65%, down from 66.5% in the prior quarter.

Microchip reported second‑quarter revenue of $1.622 billion for its fiscal 2027 year ending September 30, up 42.2% year‑over‑year and 9.2% sequentially. Industrial and data‑center segments grew 50.3% and 55.7% year‑over‑year, respectively, driving the bulk of the growth. The order‑to‑shipment ratio was well above 1, and the backlog entering the December quarter also exceeded the prior quarter, indicating that short‑term challenges are mainly on the delivery side.

CEO Steve Sanghi said most standard products previously shipped in about 4‑8 weeks, but lead times have now stretched to 6‑32 weeks depending on the product. Some test‑and‑pack providers are shifting capacity to AI customers, prompting Microchip to bring certain processes back in‑house or move them to other test houses; however, re‑qualification and ramp‑up take time, with the new capacity expected to come online gradually in the March and June 2027 quarters. Even if wafers are produced internally, downstream packaging and testing may still be constrained.

The company forecasts December‑quarter revenue of $1.573 billion to $1.638 billion, a midpoint roughly 1% lower sequentially but about 35.4% higher year‑over‑year. The base period was boosted by one‑off items: the September quarter included roughly $53 million of higher patent‑licensing revenue, channel‑inventory price adjustments and long‑term customer contracts that will not recur in December. Those items carried a 100% gross margin, and together with delayed delivery of high‑margin products and lower‑than‑planned internal utilization, they suppress the next quarter’s margin.

Data‑center demand still has growth momentum. Microchip’s PCIe Gen6 switch and retimer design‑in projects grew from 12 at the end of June and 19 at the end of September to 24 by the day of the earnings call, and the company expects these to gradually drive revenue throughout 2027. However, Sanghi cautioned that if data‑center investment slows, shipment volumes after individual projects reach mass production could still fall short of original expectations; design‑in does not equal that all demand is realized.

Cost pressures also remain. Management noted that major wafer‑foundry and test‑and‑pack suppliers are expected to raise prices again in January 2027, and Microchip currently prefers to absorb the cost rather than pass it on immediately after its August price increase. The company maintains its long‑term adjusted gross‑margin target of 65%, with future profit improvement dependent on easing supply bottlenecks, product mix and cost dynamics.

items.title: 不鏽鋼市況／歐洲進口減四成仍難去庫存終端需求疲弱拖累鋼廠出貨
items.title_en: Stainless Steel Market: European Imports Down 40% Yet Inventory Remains High, Weak End‑User Demand Burdens Steel Makers' Shipments
paras: 2026年11月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 歐洲不鏽鋼進口量大幅減少，但家電、汽車等終端需求疲弱，下游客戶仍在消化庫存，鋼廠出貨短期持續承壓。芬蘭不鏽鋼廠奧托昆普Outokumpu(OUT1V-FI)預估，第四季出貨量將較第三季減少5%至15%，歐洲業務受影響最大。
Outokumpu生產不鏽鋼鋼捲、鋼帶及板材，供應汽車、家電、管材與工業設備等下游客戶。依公司2025年報，其冷軋不鏽鋼扁平材在歐洲EU30市場市占率達28%、排名第一，在北美美墨加協定市場市占率為24%、排名第二，歐美出貨表現可作為觀察兩地製造業採購需求的參考。
西班牙同業Acerinox(ACX-ES)公布的數據顯示，今年前九月歐洲不鏽鋼進口量年減42%，同期表面消費量仍年減11%。公司指出，歐洲市場沒有如預期復甦，經銷商庫存仍高於歷史平均水準，先前累積的材料需要時間去化。
需求疲弱已反映在Outokumpu出貨表現。第三季歐洲業務出貨量季減12%，除了夏季淡季，下游客戶持續調整庫存也影響拉貨。公司表示，資料中心與能源相關需求相對強勁，但家電與汽車等消費性耐久財需求仍弱，復甦尚未擴散至整體市場。
相較之下，美洲市場較為穩健。Outokumpu第三季美洲出貨量季增7%，受惠銷量與售價改善，調整後息稅折舊攤銷前利益(EBITDA)創三年最佳表現，也支撐集團單季調整後EBITDA達1.01億歐元，與第二季大致持平。
不過，隨第四季出貨減少，加上成本上升及原料庫存、金屬衍生商品可能出現損失，Outokumpu預估，單季調整後EBITDA將與去年同期的1,000萬歐元相近，明顯低於第三季。

paras_en: November 6, 2026 (Youshu Analysis/Industry Data Center) – European stainless‑steel imports have fallen sharply, but weak end‑user demand in appliances, automobiles and other sectors means downstream customers are still digesting inventory, keeping steel‑maker shipments under pressure in the short term. Finnish stainless‑steel producer Outokumpu (OUT1V-FI) forecasts that fourth‑quarter shipments will be 5%‑15% lower than the third quarter, with its European business hit the hardest.

Outokumpu manufactures stainless‑steel coils, strips and plates for downstream customers in the automotive, appliance, pipe and industrial equipment sectors. According to its 2025 annual report, its cold‑rolled flat stainless‑steel holds a 28% share of the EU‑30 market – the top position – and a 24% share in the NAFTA region, ranking second. Its European and North‑American shipments therefore serve as a barometer of manufacturing procurement demand in the two regions.

Data released by Spanish peer Acerinox (ACX-ES) show that European stainless‑steel imports fell 42% year‑on‑year in the first nine months of this year, while domestic consumption of finished products was down 11% year‑on‑year. The company said the European market has not recovered as expected; dealer inventories remain above historical averages and previously accumulated material will take time to work through.

The weak demand is already reflected in Outokumpu’s shipment performance. European shipments fell 12% quarter‑on‑quarter in Q3, not only because of the summer off‑season but also as downstream customers continue to adjust inventories. The company noted that data‑center and energy‑related demand remains relatively strong, but consumer‑durable demand such as appliances and automobiles stays weak, and the recovery has not yet spread across the broader market.

By contrast, the Americas market is more stable. Outokumpu’s Americas shipments rose 7% quarter‑on‑quarter in Q3, benefiting from improved volumes and pricing. Adjusted EBITDA reached a three‑year high, supporting a single‑quarter adjusted EBITDA of €101 million, roughly flat with Q2.

However, with the expected drop in Q4 shipments, higher costs and the possibility of losses on raw‑material inventories and metal derivatives, Outokumpu projects that quarterly adjusted EBITDA will be close to €10 million – similar to the same period last year and markedly lower than Q3.
